lines.text: JAMES: The boss is missing...\nAhh... What’s going to happen to Team Rocket?

JESSIE: Argh! Don’t be such a wimp!\c
This is the boss we’re talking about!\c
He’s hiding himself for now, but he must be
preparing for the next scheme!
JAMES: ...Yeah, of course!\c\nThen let’s steal Pokémon all over the world\nto help the boss!
MEOWTH: ...Mrawr!
JAMES: Ah! It’s that annoying twerp again!
JESSIE: Why are you eavesdropping on us?
JAMES: Those who are in Team Rocket’s way\nwon’t get away unscathed!

JESSIE: Hey, twerp, you can’t battle the both of
us with just one Pokémon!\c
You’d better go get another and come back to
take us on!
JESSIE: You’re just a twerp.\nWhy are you so strong?
...Is it because of that [VAR POKNAME(0002)]?\c\nYou can probably go all out because you’re with\nthat Pokémon.
JAMES: With that [VAR POKNAME(0002)], we may be\nable to conquer the world!\c\nHey, do you want to join Team Rocket?
No way!
Well...
JAMES: OK. Fine.\nHumph, we’re enemies after all!
But if you do change your mind, come back\nanytime. I’ll give you this. I made it myself.
You got a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Blast-Off Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] from Team Rocket!
You put the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Blast-Off Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] in your Clothing Trunk!

JESSIE: ...
What’s this?\c
Why do I feel so refreshed?\c
You’ve been such a troublesome little twerp,
and yet...
JAMES: It’s great to have times like this for\na change once in a while, isn’t it?
JESSIE: You might be right.
JESSIE & JAMES: We feel great!
MEOWTH: Meow, meow!
